text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much for the present~! 
Pandora-san!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's a cake from a super popular 
shop, y'know~? Plus, I had them decorate 
it like crazy with PreFighter colors!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
P-Pandora-san...! This brings tears to a 
princess's eyes!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Let's take a photo to remember it and 
post it on Umastagram! It'll totally look 
super aesthetic♡"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Then we will be needing those as 
well! You prepare as many of them as one's 
age, correct?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aah~ you mean THAT, right? The thing where 
you light 'em and blow 'em oouut♪ It 
creates such an emo vibe, I love it~♡

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Light the fire in your heart— and 
blow it away! That giant boulder!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, a big rock... A ROCK!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll smash as many boulders as my age with 
this Princess Fist of mine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is the Princess Birthday, Power Form! 
I shall smash everything to smithereens 
again this year!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please make sure to take a good photo of 
me blowing away all the rocks and eating 
the cake!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...... Is that really what birthdays are 
like?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Well~, it looks totally Insta-worthy, 
so who cares!
